incidents.name: PRXVTStaking reward accounting not settled on transfer
incidents.notes: PRXVTStaking issued transferable stPRXVT receipts but never settled or reset reward accounting on transfer, so moving the staked balance through a series of fresh CREATE2 addresses let each one report the full accumulated earned() and call claimReward() again.

sources.ref: onchain review: PRXVTStaking (verified source) created 2025-12-31 by 0xa116959ffe4f64b82e294ef2209b34423c078e9f (not the attacker 0x7407f9bd...), no Upgraded events - the exploited code was under 8 hours old. The PoC loop deploys Attack2 helpers with CREATE2, transfers stPRXVT to each and calls claimReward(). Loss 32.8 ETH; DefiLlama records $97,000 (Staking Logic Flaw, Base).
